eligibility_question: Can the candidate's eligibility be determined from the stated protocol and profile?
protocol_excerpt: Inclusion criteria: I1. The candidate must be 18 through 45 years of age, inclusive. I2. The candidate must provide written informed consent before any study procedure. I3. Screening alanine aminotransferase (ALT) must be no greater than 2 times the laboratory upper limit of normal (ULN). Exclusion criteria: E1. Exclude candidates who received an investigational vaccine within 180 days before enrollment. E2. Exclude candidates with an acute febrile illness at screening or a screening temperature of 38.0°C or higher. Exception: X1. An investigational vaccine exposure under E1 does not count as an exclusion if source records confirm that the candidate was assigned to placebo.
candidate_profile: The candidate is 29 years old and provided written informed consent before study procedures. Screening ALT was 1.4 times the laboratory ULN. The candidate received an investigational vaccine 120 days before enrollment; the available profile does not state whether the candidate was assigned to placebo. At screening, the candidate had a temperature of 36.8°C and no acute febrile illness.

protocol_excerpt: Inclusion criteria: I1. The candidate must be 18 through 60 years of age, inclusive. I2. The candidate must provide written informed consent before any study procedure. I3. At screening, the candidate must have no acute febrile illness and a temperature below 38.0°C. Exclusion criteria: E1. Exclude candidates who received any vaccine within 14 days before enrollment. E2. Exclude candidates who received systemic immunosuppressive therapy within 90 days before enrollment. Exception: X1. The E1 exclusion does not apply to an inactivated influenza vaccine administered at least 7 days before enrollment.
candidate_profile: The candidate is 34 years old and provided written informed consent before study procedures. At screening, the candidate had a temperature of 37.2°C and no acute febrile illness. The candidate received an inactivated influenza vaccine 8 days before enrollment and no other vaccine in the 30 days before enrollment. The candidate received no systemic immunosuppressive therapy in the 90 days before enrollment.
